name: home-freeroam

status.title: Free roam
lines: Free roam: Center, Left, Right, until each is at 10 % or 0.1 h. Ctrl+C (or ./run-fleet-pi.sh freeroam-stop) stops every robot.

Board assumed: x 0 to 122 cm, y 0 to 122 cm (122 x 122 cm, from the simulator's board). Moves end 16 cm or more inside it (90 x 90 cm usable); turns on the spot 9.2 cm in. Walls or objects inside it are found during the run: each front stop or edge-guard stop becomes a keep-out (events: keep-out; keepouts.csv).
[   60.0] Left move 30% 19 moves; Center move 48% 23 moves; Right move 13% 20 moves
[  120.0] Left move 0% 34 moves; Center move 17% 43 moves; Right move 3% 34 moves
The run ends: the time cap (0.1 h).

robots.words: Practice: 2 simulated robots (Left, Center); each run finds them by their wiggle

where: This looks like home (the 4 x 4 ft board) (the table measures 122 x 122 cm, its size and its cameras USB 2.0 Camera and EMEET SmartCam C950 plugged in).
